note: Both sets decompose the wiring schedule accurately, but Set B additionally captures the page's key equipment facts — SUB-PANEL PV 120/240V 1-phase 3-wire, the 2.8 kW inverter with ground fault, the 60A DC NFDS and the 200A/2P NFDS — which Set A omits entirely. Both sets make the same two binding errors: they attach the AL 3#4/0, #4G., 2-1/2"C. schedule entry (150) to the main-service-panel run, although the diagram labels that run as circuit 50 (CU: 3#6, #8G., 1"C.), and both attach the 'AL: 3#4/0, ARMORED CABLE' quote (row 151) to symbol 150. Set B adds some noise (garbled value '200/2 A/P' for 200A/2P, and meaningless 'conditions: C' parsed from the conduit notation), while Set A's claims are cleaner and better quoted but confined to the wiring schedule, so B's coverage of the important facts tips the balance.
